_what: child_cam_bridge v1: lightweight the camera bridge of the AquaBeacon child unit by topology optimisation, keeping every functional interface of the current part (328.1 cm3 / PETG ~407 g).
_geometry_source: child_cam_bridge_v1.scad (part=preserve/obstacle/design_space/preserve_cuts). Every dimension is a restatement of the Customizer values in child_cam_bridge.scad / child_side_bumper.scad / child_jaw_gate.scad (double definition -- fix both).
_preserve: HP4 + HP5 seat pads on the central column (x +-25, y 74.35..80.35, z 145..195 and 75..125; the bolted faces and the M5x4 seats), child_cam_mount seats x2 (deck full thickness, x 58..92 / -92..-58, y 75.05..119.05, z 44.95..52.95 -- top face is the register plane, bottom face is the nut-trap opening), side-bumper end plates x2 (x 114..120 / -120..-114, y 67..128, z 44.95..80 -- the outer face x=+-120 is the mating face of the bumper L-foot and carries the M5x2 seats), front-edge bumper x2 (x 30..120 / -120..-30, y 122..128, z 44.95..80 -- 2 mm ahead of the lens plane, the L4 load-introduction face).
_obstacle: camera + waterproof case AABB x2 (x 27.65..122.35, y 74.1..120, z 82.95..167.05), child_cam_mount body x2 (x 58..92, y 75.05..119.05, z 52.95..82.95), lens field-of-view cone x2 (apex at (+-75,120,125), +Y, half-angle 77.5 deg = diagonal FOV 155 deg, which encloses the 145 deg horizontal one; run forward only to the 8 mm hood limit), jaw-gate HP4/HP5 shelves (x +-25, y 62.35..74.35, z 145..195 and 75..125), tool access for the 8x M5 into HP4/HP5 (Q12 along +Y from the column front face y=80.35 to the front of the design space).
_obstacles_not_declared: child_side_bumper (L-foot starts at x=120 = ds_x1, main wall at x=124.35 -- outside the design space by construction), jaw-gate shell r64.35 (any y >= ds_y0 = 67 is at r >= 67 > 64.35, so it never reaches the box; jaw_gate has nothing else at y >= 67 outside |x| <= 25), HP-L shelf (z <= 40 < ds_z0 = 44.95). Declaring them would only inflate the domain bounding box.
_design_space: box x -120..120, y 67..128, z 44.95..195 -- exactly the current part bbox (240 x 61 x 150.05). Not widened: x +-120 is the 240 frame and the bumper inner face is 124.35; y1 = lens_y + 8 is the hood limit; y0 = 67 is the 2.65 mm gate-shell clearance; z1 = 195 is the HP4 seat top; z0 = 44.95 because anything lower buries the M5 nut-trap openings in the deck underside (that binds before the HP-L +2 rule at z=42).
_loads: L1 operational hoist 3g (camera + case 0.35 kg each) / L4 frontal impact 150 N -Y on one front-edge bumper (requirements 3, factor included) / L2s side impact 150 N -X on one end plate / L6 handling: lift by one camera, 100 N +Z on one cam_mount seat. Supports are always the HP4/HP5 seat pads (bolted to child_jaw_gate).
_not_covered: The md names the M5 heat-set insert pull-out at HP4/HP5 (~355 N/bolt at L2 300 N) as the real governing item. Fixing those pads xyz means the FEA cannot report it -- it is still an open test item.

cases.name: L1 operational hoist 3g: HP4/HP5 fixed, camera + case (0.35 kg each) hang off the mount seats, bridge self-weight at 3 g
L4 frontal impact 150 N (-Y) on one front-edge bumper, HP4/HP5 react
L2s side impact 150 N (-X) on the starboard end plate through the side bumper, HP4/HP5 react
L6 handling: the unit is picked up by one camera, 100 N (+Z) on the starboard cam_mount seat, HP4/HP5 react
